children: Dongwoon Anatech received Korea's Digital Medical Device Manufacturing GMP certification for D-SaLife, its saliva-based glucose monitoring system under development. Commercial-production IVD GMP certification and clinical studies remain outstanding.
Received digital medical device GMP certification
Advances D-SaLife's regulatory process, but does not establish commercial readiness or product approval.
Commercial-production IVD GMP certification still required
The certification does not authorize commercial production; another manufacturing certification remains outstanding.
Clinical studies and remaining regulatory steps planned
Clinical evidence and further approvals are still needed before the system can reach the market.
This is a company plan, not an approval; timing and completion remain uncertain.
US FDA registration aimed for by 2029
The stated target is several years away and remains dependent on development and regulatory progress.

This is a mid-cycle regulatory milestone for D-SaLife, which has been in development since 2017 and received clinical-trial-product IVD GMP certification in July 2026. Further clinical studies, commercial-production IVD GMP certification and regulatory approvals would be needed for a larger catalyst.
